# Healwise — Design Notes

## Source Template

- **ColorLib Name:** Drcare
- **URL:** https://colorlib.com/wp/template/drcare/
- **Preview:** https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/drcare/
- **Category:** Medical/Healthcare

## Design Tokens (from css/style.css)

- **Brand:** #2f89fc (blue accent)
- **Dark:** #1c1d21 (navbar, footer backgrounds)
- **Paper:** #f8f9fa (light section backgrounds)
- **Mist:** #6c757d (muted body text)
- **Ink:** #212529 (dark headings)
- **Font:** Work Sans (Google Fonts, weights 300–800)

## Section Order

1. Top Info Bar (address/email/phone)
2. Dark Navbar (logo + nav links + CTA)
3. Hero (2-slide carousel, overlay, headline, CTA)
4. Services (4 cards: doctors, emergency, outdoor, 24h)
5. About (split: image + text + 4 features)
6. CTA Banner (full-width, consultation offer)
7. Departments (tabbed: 5 departments)
8. Testimonials
9. Stats Counter (4 metrics)
10. Pricing (4 tiers)
11. Blog (3 posts)
12. Footer (4 columns, Component Dock link)
